title: Teens who chose an AI companion over a human for a serious conversation vs. who shared personal info with one

source.name: Talk, Trust, and Trade-Offs: How and Why Teens Use AI Companions
source.publisher: Common Sense Media (survey fielded by NORC at the University of Chicago)

notes: From the same 2025 survey: a third of teens (33%) say they have chosen an AI companion over an actual person for a serious conversation, and a quarter (25%) have shared personal information with an AI companion.

points.label: Shared personal info with an AI companion
